name: dev-workflow
description: Spec-to-ship workflow for FE, BE or full-stack projects on top of superpowers: spec → plan + test plan → TDD → UI testing with Chrome DevTools MCP → race-condition & load testing → final report, with review gates, a 3-round bug feedback loop, a quick mode for small fixes, a status command and an optional live dashboard. / Quy trình phát triển P0–P6 cho dự án FE, BE hoặc fullstack.
